question: Based on the results of Experiment 1, if water at 20 °C had been drained through a tube with an inner diameter of 5 mm, the drain time would most likely have been:

options.C: more than 19 s but less than 96 s.

question: Which of the following observations would best test the prediction Scientist 3 makes about the interval between events?

options.A: Timing the events over the next several years to see whether the interval shortens.

question: The researchers trapped mosquitoes at all six sites during the same week. Based on the passage, this was most likely done so that:

options.A: the same 200 mosquitoes could be recaptured at each site.
options.B: the frequency of the S allele would be the same at every site.
options.C: the mosquitoes at every site would have been exposed to the insecticide.
options.D: differences among the sites would not be confused with the change in R frequency that occurs over the months after spraying.

question: Which of the following investigations would best allow the two viewpoints to be tested against each other?

options.A: Determining the age of the fossils in the limestone bed that lies below the spherule layer.
options.B: Determining whether the nickel in the spherules occurs as droplets of metal or is dispersed through the glass.
options.C: Measuring the diameter of the largest spherule found at Site B.
options.D: Measuring the thickness of the limestone bed that lies directly above the spherule layer at each of the three sites.
